features.name: Cele Peterson Rose Garden
features.description: Cele Peterson Rose Garden is the formal rose garden and gazebo area on Concert Place inside Gene C. Reid Park, with seasonal displays and a separate reservation program.
features.source_label: City of Tucson Parks and Recreation

features.name: Georges DeMeester Outdoor Performance Center
features.description: Georges DeMeester Outdoor Performance Center is Reid Park's outdoor bandshell and sloped lawn for concerts, festivals, and family events, with room for blankets and portable chairs.
features.source_label: City of Tucson Parks and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: City of Tucson Parks and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Georges DeMeester Outdoor Performance Center at Reid Park

features.name: Hi Corbett Field
features.description: Hi Corbett Field is the historic baseball stadium on the east side of Gene C. Reid Park, reached from Camino Campestre rather than the park's main Randolph Way address.
features.source_label: City of Tucson Parks and Recreation
